PB-BRUTE-FORCE-001.title: Brute Force Attack Response — Smart Grid
PB-BRUTE-FORCE-001.description: Response playbook for credential brute force attacks targeting SCADA, RTU, PLC, and HMI authentication interfaces.
immediate_actions: Block source IP at perimeter firewall and OT firewall.
Enable account lockout on targeted service (e.g., Modbus gateway, SSH, web HMI).
Force password reset for all potentially compromised accounts.
Capture network packet trace for forensic analysis.
investigation_steps: Review authentication logs for failed login patterns.
Check if any accounts were successfully compromised.
Correlate with IDS/IPS alerts for lateral movement indicators.
Verify integrity of PLC/RTU configurations.
containment_actions: Isolate affected network segment from the control network.
Disable remote access services (SSH/RDP/VNC) until investigation complete.
Deploy temporary network ACLs restricting access to critical assets.
recovery_actions: Implement multi-factor authentication on all remote access points.
Rotate all credentials on affected systems.
Deploy account lockout policies with progressive delays.
Update firewall rules to rate-limit authentication attempts.

PB-DOS-001.title: Denial of Service Attack Response — ICS/SCADA
PB-DOS-001.description: Response playbook for volumetric or protocol-level DoS attacks targeting SCADA servers, RTUs, and network infrastructure.
immediate_actions: Activate DDoS mitigation at ISP and local boundary.
Switch to backup communication channels for critical SCADA links.
Notify operations team to monitor for physical grid anomalies.
Enable emergency manual control procedures if SCADA is unavailable.
investigation_steps: Capture traffic samples to identify attack vector and source.
Determine if attack is volumetric, protocol-based, or application-layer.
Check if attack is a diversion for a more targeted intrusion.
Review log data from upstream ISP for traffic origin analysis.
containment_actions: Deploy rate limiting on affected interfaces.
Black-hole route confirmed attack source prefixes.
Redirect traffic through scrubbing center if available.
Isolate non-critical services to preserve bandwidth for SCADA.
recovery_actions: Restore normal network routing after attack subsides.
Verify SCADA system integrity and reconnect RTUs.
Deploy additional traffic filtering rules based on attack signature.
Update incident response plan with lessons learned.

PB-RANSOMWARE-001.title: Ransomware Response — Critical Infrastructure
PB-RANSOMWARE-001.description: Response playbook for ransomware incidents affecting IT/OT convergence zones in smart grid infrastructure.
immediate_actions: Disconnect affected systems from the network immediately.
DO NOT pay ransom — preserve evidence for law enforcement.
Activate air-gap between IT and OT networks.
Notify CISA (1-888-282-0870) and FBI Cyber Division.
Switch to manual/backup operations for grid control.
investigation_steps: Identify ransomware variant from file extensions and ransom note.
Determine initial infection vector (phishing, exploit, RDP).
Map lateral movement path through the network.
Assess whether OT systems were impacted or only IT.
containment_actions: Isolate all infected segments from production OT network.
Disable inter-VLAN routing between IT and OT zones.
Block known C2 domains and IPs at DNS and firewall.
Preserve disk images of infected systems for forensics.
recovery_actions: Restore from verified clean offline backups.
Rebuild affected systems from golden images.
Scan all systems with updated anti-malware before reconnection.
Implement network micro-segmentation to prevent future spread.
Conduct post-incident tabletop exercise within 30 days.

PB-RECON-001.title: Reconnaissance & Scanning Response
PB-RECON-001.description: Response playbook for network scanning and reconnaissance activity targeting ICS/SCADA infrastructure.
immediate_actions: Log all scanning source IPs and ports targeted.
Verify no vulnerabilities exist on discovered services.
Increase monitoring on targeted network segments.
investigation_steps: Analyze scan patterns (sequential ports, specific ICS ports like 502, 20000, 47808).
Check if scanning is from known threat actor infrastructure.
Correlate with any recent phishing campaigns or credential leaks.
containment_actions: Block scanning source IPs at perimeter firewall.
Reduce attack surface by disabling unnecessary services.
Deploy honeypots to monitor for follow-up exploitation.
recovery_actions: Conduct vulnerability scan of targeted assets.
Patch any vulnerabilities found during scan.
Update network firewall rules to restrict external access.
Review and harden ICS device configurations.

PB-EXPLOIT-001.title: Active Exploitation Response — ICS
PB-EXPLOIT-001.description: Response playbook for active exploitation of known or zero-day vulnerabilities in ICS/SCADA systems.
immediate_actions: Isolate exploited system from the network.
Preserve volatile memory and network logs.
Check for persistence mechanisms (backdoors, scheduled tasks, implants).
Notify vendor PSIRT for ICS-specific exploits.
investigation_steps: Identify the CVE or vulnerability being exploited.
Determine if exploitation was successful (check for payload execution).
Assess impact on physical process (grid stability, safety systems).
Review historical logs for prior reconnaissance or probing.
containment_actions: Apply emergency patch or vendor-provided workaround.
Deploy virtual patching via IPS/WAF rules.
Restrict access to the vulnerable service to trusted IPs only.
Monitor for indicators of compromise on adjacent systems.
recovery_actions: Apply vendor patch and verify fix.
Restore system from known-good backup if integrity is questionable.
Conduct full vulnerability assessment of similar assets.
Update threat intelligence feeds with new IoCs.

PB-MITM-001.title: Man-in-the-Middle Attack Response — ICS Protocols
PB-MITM-001.description: Response playbook for adversary-in-the-middle attacks on industrial protocols (Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850).
immediate_actions: Verify integrity of control commands reaching PLCs/RTUs.
Compare expected vs actual process values at field devices.
Enable encrypted communication on affected protocol links.
Isolate the compromised network segment.
investigation_steps: Analyze ARP tables for evidence of ARP spoofing.
Review network taps for duplicate or altered packets.
Check if SCADA commands match operator logs.
Inspect switch port security and MAC address tables.
containment_actions: Enable static ARP entries on critical network devices.
Deploy 802.1X port-based network access control.
Activate encrypted protocol modes (TLS, IEC 62351).
Remove unauthorized devices from the network.
recovery_actions: Verify all PLC/RTU configurations against golden baselines.
Deploy network encryption for all ICS protocol traffic.
Implement continuous monitoring for protocol anomalies.
Conduct MITM resilience testing on critical communication paths.
